before: createWebrtcCollaboration used the public demo signaling endpoints when signaling was omitted. y-webrtc announced every room in the page through every signaling connection, and a destroyed room left its signaling socket open.
after: createWebrtcCollaboration and the WebRTC hooks refuse a room without signaling before any connection opens. Each signaling connection carries only the rooms that listed its URL, and destroying the last room on a server closes its socket. Explicit endpoints, including DEMO_SIGNALING_ENDPOINTS, connect as before.
reason: Only room setup and signaling routing change. Peers that list the same signaling server still meet on it, and a connected room uses the same y-webrtc provider, signaling password, framing, and shared Yjs state as before, so released participants keep the same meaning for shared data and updates.
